card.name: Regional climate descriptions in geography text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation in climate or geography passages about temperatures and seasons, where the next word is likely a region such as northern, coastal or southern parts of a place.

modes.label: Climate comparisons
modes.description: Words like moderate, highest or prominent in a sentence that compares conditions across parts of a country or state.
modes.example: Winters are more<< moderate>> along the eastern coast.

modes.label: Sentence ends after climate figures
modes.description: A period or linking word right after temperature ranges, just before the text moves on to regional detail.

modes.label: Direction words before regions
modes.description: A direction word such as southern right before the word regions or parts of a state.
modes.example: Spring reaches the<< southern>> regions of the state in late March and

card.writes: It pushes the model toward region words like regions, northern, regional and eastern, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires in geography passages on climate and helps predict that a region, such as the northern part of a country, will be named next.
